knowledge_base.institute: CA Dayanand Bongale Stock Market Training Institute

contact.app: Chanakya App — available on Google Play Store

faqs.question: Who is CA Dayanand Bongale?
faqs.answer: CA Dayanand Bongale is a qualified Chartered Accountant and founder of a Stock Market Training Institute in Bangalore. He completed his CA in 2010 and holds 5 qualifications: CA, B.Com, M.Com, MBA, and ISA. He is known as the Hedging Star for his philosophy of always protecting capital while earning profits.

faqs.question: What is the course called?
faqs.answer: The core course is called Trading Simplified. It covers everything from stock market basics to advanced hedging strategies using CA Bongale's proprietary Chanakya Analysis method.

faqs.question: How long is the course?
faqs.answer: The course has 3 days of theory classes followed by 15 days of live trading floor access. Theory is typically on weekends so it does not disrupt work or college schedules.

faqs.question: What topics are covered?
faqs.answer: The course covers: basics of the stock market, fundamental analysis, technical analysis, candlestick analysis, indicator analysis, options and futures, hidden secrets of options, Spatha Swaras of the stock market, Chanakya Analysis, and 20 world-class hedging strategies.

faqs.question: What is Chanakya Analysis?
faqs.answer: Chanakya Analysis is CA Dayanand Bongale's own proprietary trading methodology. It is described as the secret of successful trading and is the core of the Trading Simplified course. It focuses on consistent profits while protecting capital through strategic hedging.

faqs.question: How many hedging strategies are taught?
faqs.answer: The course teaches 20 world-class hedging strategies. Hedging is the core focus of this institute — CA Bongale's philosophy is to protect your invested capital at all times while earning profits.

faqs.question: Is this course for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. The course is designed for complete beginners with zero prior knowledge of the stock market. It starts from the basics and builds up progressively.

faqs.question: Who is this course suitable for?
faqs.answer: The course is suitable for college students, housewives and homemakers, working professionals both male and female, complete beginners, and anyone who wants financial independence through the stock market.

faqs.question: Is this course affordable?
faqs.answer: Yes. The institute is specifically positioned as a budget-friendly, small-budget-accessible program. It is designed so that even students and homemakers can enroll without financial strain.

faqs.question: Can a working professional join with a busy schedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. Theory classes are only 3 days and are held on weekends. This means zero disruption to your job. Trading floor access is then available for 15 days at a flexible schedule.

faqs.question: Is there an app for the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Chanakya app is available on the Google Play Store. It provides digital learning resources and extends the learning beyond classroom sessions.

faqs.question: Does the institute have a YouTube channel?
faqs.answer: Yes. CA Dayanand Bongale launched his YouTube channel in October 2022 with free educational videos on stock markets and finance. You can check it out to get a feel for his teaching style before enrolling.

faqs.question: When was the institute started?
faqs.answer: CA Bongale launched his YouTube channel in October 2022 and started the coaching institute in Bangalore in March 2023.

faqs.question: How can I enroll?
faqs.answer: You can enroll by calling or WhatsApp messaging at plus 91 63629 85767, or by emailing learnfromca@gmail.com. You can also reach out through Instagram at cadayanandbongale or Facebook at cadayanandbongale1.

faqs.question: What makes this institute different from others?
faqs.answer: Five key differentiators: first, it is affordable and budget friendly. Second, only 3 days of weekend theory. Third, the proprietary Chanakya Analysis method not available anywhere else. Fourth, 20 hedging strategies with a unique focus on capital protection. Fifth, it is practitioner-led by a qualified CA with over 15 years of market experience.

When you consider that you get 3 days of theory, 15 days of live trading practice, Chanakya Analysis, and 20 hedging strategies, the value is very high. Also, the skills you learn here can generate returns far beyond the course fee. Can I share the exact fee structure with you on WhatsApp so you can see for yourself?

That is exactly why this course was designed the way it is. Only 3 days of theory — on weekends — so there is zero disruption to your work or studies. And the 15 days of trading floor access is flexible. Hundreds of working professionals have completed this course without it affecting their jobs at all.

objection_handling.objection: I don't know anything about the stock market
objection_handling.response: That is perfectly fine — in fact that is exactly who this course is made for. You start from absolute zero. CA Bongale covers every basic concept first before moving to advanced strategies. No background knowledge is needed at all.

objection_handling.objection: The stock market is too risky
objection_handling.response: You are right that risk exists — but risk can be managed, and that is precisely what makes this course unique. CA Bongale is known as the Hedging Star. His entire philosophy is built around protecting your capital first, then earning profits. You will learn 20 hedging strategies specifically designed to prevent major losses. It is not gambling — it is a learnable skill.

objection_handling.objection: I have tried other courses before and they did not work
objection_handling.response: I hear you and that is a genuine concern. Most courses teach theory but skip the most important part — protecting your money. What makes CA Bongale's approach different is Chanakya Analysis, his proprietary methodology, combined with 20 hedging strategies. Plus you get 15 days of actual live trading practice, not just classroom theory. It is very different from what you may have experienced before.
